title: Experiment Plane — Record + Tracker + State Machine
description: Implement experiment record tracking with full lineage. Records cannot be deleted, parameter changes create new records, AI changes are marked.
action: Create synapse/experiment/ module: (1) ExperimentRecord dataclass with fields: experiment_id, name, research_task_id, data_version, factor_version, model_version, split_method, parameters, started_at, completed_at, status (draft/running/succeeded/failed), artifacts, created_by; (2) ExperimentTracker that creates records, updates status, prevents deletion (raises EXPERIMENT_DELETE_NOT_ALLOWED from error registry), creates new record on parameter change; (3) State machine for research task lifecycle.
implementation: Create synapse/experiment/record.py: @dataclass ExperimentRecord with all contract fields, @dataclass ResearchTask with state machine (draft->planned->data_ready->factor_defined->audited->backtested->risk_reviewed->reported->archived), from_yaml/to_yaml

Create synapse/experiment/tracker.py: create_experiment(name, data_version, factor_version, parameters) -> ExperimentRecord, update_status(experiment_id, new_status, triggered_by), list_experiments(), delete_experiment() raises error (govanance: cannot delete)
Implement state machine transitions: validate_transition(current_state, new_state) using allowed_transitions dict
Write tests: test_experiment_record.py (create, serialize, status tracking), test_experiment_tracker.py (create, update status, verify cannot delete)

criteria: synapse/experiment/tracker.py contains 'delete_experiment' that raises error or returns error code
